Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct ONLY the small chart-document icon in Lighthouse LH09-0012 image1. ORIGINAL image2 controls icon glyphgeometry, proportions, opticalstroke, alignment andfinedetail.
The original has a faint chartgrid behind its risingtrendline. Restore this subtle fine grid inside the same small squarepictogram, retaining the original relative grid/trendline anatomy and tinyopticalsize. Fine lowcontrast neutralgrid, slate#526173 risinglineandoutline, no redwarningmeaning or randomcolors. Do notmakeiconlarger, filled, embossed or foldedpage.
Keep image1's exact Japanese「関連資料」「利用者の声と活動改善についての計画書」, nearbythinplus, layout, RegularMeiryo size/weight, alignedbaselines andpurewhitecanvas unchanged. No addedtext, controls, row, badge, card ormetric. Only iconfinegrid correction. Onecomponent staticcandidate.
reviewNotes: 限定修正を実見し資料アイコン内の細いグリッド復元を確認。関連資料/利用者の声と活動改善についての計画書の全文、追加の近接位置を再確認。小チャート形状を維持し赤の装飾線のみ補助スレートへ統一。外周余白と厳密な書体/ベクター同一性は未証明。候補のエージェント目視確認、所有者承認・新ネイティブ・実装とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
